warnings: Beam / slab sections of sheet 7. All bars printed with ø → type RB (section 0.6). 'คอม้า L/5' bars merged into main_bar.bottom with the split in the note (section 7). B5 / B6 (1.20 deep) carry three rows of side bars recorded as main_bar.middle (section 6).
B12' and B23' print their bars 'ตาม B12' / 'ตาม B13' (as for B12 / B13) — recorded as printed.
Slab callouts sit in a crowded strip at the bottom right; S1 / SB callouts were assigned to the nearest slab detail by position (flagged).

B1 (thin eave fascia panel), B7 (stepped canopy edge beam), B10 (gutter beam) and B11 (ปั้นลม) have composite / thin sections with partly illegible dimensions — recorded with low scores; face assignment for B7/B11 is by bar position. Second op04 pass (2026-10-22): the first pass listed a 'B3'' among this sheet's details and said its elevation was not extracted — re-read, there is no mark B3' on sheet 7; the label at the bottom right is B23' (section .60 deep, '4 ø25 มม. ตาม B13' / '2 ø25 มม. ตาม B13', ป ø6 @ .15 — already in elements). The sheet's beam elevations are B2 (now transcribed into B2's note) and B3 (already in B3's note); no other elevation is printed.

Cross-sheet (2026-10-22): the rear elevation on หน้า06 (รูปด้านหลัง) prints 'เสาเอ็น คสล. 0.15x0.30 ม. เหล็ก 3ø12มม. ป.ø6 มม.@0.15 ม. มีบัวล้อมข้าง' for the balcony-edge post; this sheet's section 'เสาริมระเบียง' reads .12 x .30 — the section sheet wins for member spec (op01 precedence 2), recorded as read, flagged on the element.
